detail.longDescription: I just launched a new project: renovate-operator A Kubernetes operator that deploys and manages Renovate Bot at scale! 🤖 Automate dependency updates across repos with scheduling, Git platform discovery and Helm/Kustomize support. Open source & community-driven. Would be happy to get some feedback, boost is also welcome :mastolove: https:// github.com/thegeeklab/renovate -operator # K8s # Kubernetes # GitOps # opensource # renovatebot
